name: Grilled pig intestine
summary: Young pig intestine grilled by Muong households at bản Heo, xã Tà Hộc, huyện Mai Sơn. Vietnamnet, on 16 March 2019, washes it and works it with salt and lime, boils it about 2 minutes with a little ginger and salt, rinses it, seasons it about 2 minutes with hạt nêm, mì chính, satay, fish sauce, pounded scallion, garlic, and chili, and ground pepper, then rolls it on a small stick or a lay stem, ties it with bamboo, and grills it. It is for guests, weddings, and Tết.
origin: Bản Heo, xã Tà Hộc, huyện Mai Sơn. Vietnamnet, 16 March 2019.
howToEat: From the stick, at a guest meal, a wedding, or Tết. An hour and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Bản Heo, xã Tà Hộc, huyện Mai Sơn, along the Đà. A city shop was not named.
